name: Sakihiko
source:
The son of the original creator of the Karyuu school of fighting [url=/c47225]Jishou[/url].
He has a rare talent despite being so young and he works as an assistant instructor at the dojo.
He takes orders from [url=/c47200]Iori[/url] and helps with spying missions, but he isn't seen as reliable by those around him.
He talks a lot and his cheeky way of speaking makes him stand out.
